map.买方一定比卖方好？: Is the buyer always better off than the seller?
map.不一定；买方亏有限但胜率常低，卖方胜率高但尾部风险大，按观点与资金匹配。: No. Buyers have limited losses but usually a low win rate, while sellers have a high win rate but large tail risk; match the position to your view and capital.
map.盈亏平衡点含权利金吗？: Does the break-even include the premium?
map.含。看涨买方须涨过 K+权利金才回本，这是常被忽略的成本。: Yes. A long call must rise above K + premium to break even — a cost that is often overlooked.
